lessons.culture: Haggling is an expected part of shopping in the traditional souks of Jeddah and the historic areas around the Haram in Makkah and Madinah, especially for textiles, spices, and souvenirs. Buyers who never try to negotiate down are unusual, and sellers view it as a friendly part of the transaction. Keep a respectful tone, especially in sacred areas.
